atoms.a: Work and travel means going to another country
atoms.sound: Work and travel means going to another country to work for a while.

atoms.a: Work-life balance means finding a good mix between
atoms.sound: Work-life balance means finding a good mix between your work and your personal life.
Volunteer work means doing a job without getting paid.

instruction.text: Ordne die Vor- und Nachteile von Work and Travel passend zu.
instruction.sound: Ordne die Vor und Nachteile von <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2_2025'>Work and Travel</voice> passend zu.

atoms.a: You might not have as much time to travel around if you have to work a lot.
Usually you can't stay longer than 1-2 years in one country while doing your work and travel.
You can meet new people, see new places and learn about different cultures.
You can improve your language skills.

instruction.text: Tippe mögliche Gründe für eine ehrenamtliche Arbeit an.

atoms.b:
Having a good work-life balance …

… reduces stress and therefore is good for your ((health)).

… allows you to develop healthy relationships outside of work, such as ((friendships)).

… lets you do things you enjoy, like pursuing ((hobbies)).

… can help you be better at your ((job --wisdom)).

instruction.text: Höre zu und fülle die Lücken.

atoms.a: What do you look for in a job?
atoms.b: What do you look for in a ((job))?

atoms.a: For me, salary plays an important role. I would like to have a well-paying job in the future.
atoms.b: For me, ((salary)) plays an important role. I would like to have a ((well-paying)) job in the future.

atoms.a: Salary isn't that important to me. But I want to work with people. I think a job where you work in a team would be great.
atoms.b: Salary isn't that important to me. But I want to work with ((people)). I think a job where you work in a ((team)) would be great.

atoms.a: I have no problem with working alone. On the contrary, I love spending hours creating something on my own. I think the most important thing for me is to find a job that I really enjoy, so that I don't get bored at work. What about you?
atoms.b: I have no problem with ((working)) alone. On the contrary, I ((love)) spending hours creating something on my own. I think the most important thing for me is to find a job that I really ((enjoy)), so that I don't get bored at ((work)). What about you?

atoms.a: One day I want to work in Argentina. That is my priority. So my future job just has to be located there.
atoms.b: One day I want to work in ((Argentina)). That is my priority. So my future job just has to be ((located)) there.
